name: smwmusic-asterix-and-the-great-rescue-roman-encampment
title: Asterix and the Great Rescue - Roman Encampment
description:
World 2 theme from Asterix and the Great Rescue on the Genesis / MegaDrive. A march that sounds quite sombre and could fit a "serious" level, like a cemetery or, well, ancient Rome.

The original had weird "muddy footstep"-like percussion sounds, turned into a distortion guitar here.
